title: b.ResetTimer() inside loop — timer reset on every iteration destroys measurement
expected_feedback: b.ResetTimer() must be called once before the loop, not inside it; move it between setup and the for loop
expected_modernization: On Go >= 1.24 the whole defect class disappears: `for b.Loop()` starts the timer itself, so there is no ResetTimer to misplace. Recommend converting rather than only relocating the call.
